verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms SAM.gov serves a real robots.txt (HTTP 200) with a standard published crawl policy. That policy tells a keyless agent which content paths it may crawl before it fetches anything. Missing for 10: the probe does not reproduce the actual directives, such as per-path or AI-agent-specific user-agent rules, so their exact contents are unverified.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service publishes a real robots.txt, so an agent can know what it may read before fetching anything

citations.quote: HTTP 200 at https://sam.gov/robots.txt (observed 2026-10-05) — a standard published crawl policy; content paths are crawlable to a keyless agent.
